payload.title: the integrator's role-routing tier
payload.body: Ruled: the integrator routes like the implementer — omp nearest built-in role `task`, Claude tier `sonnet`. Its work is spec-bounded mechanics (merge onto the plan's line, run the whole check, commit records of decisions it is handed); it decides nothing, so it needs no principal-grade model, and a red gate goes up to the architect rather than being reasoned about.
